name: Agulhas Current
scope: Regional southward Agulhas reference route from 27 degrees S to a 40 degrees S retroflection gate near 19 degrees E. Includes an editorial approach to the turning region; stops before the eastward Agulhas Return Current. Excludes upstream Mozambique/East Madagascar branches, leakage and ring trajectories. This is a regional extent convention, not the narrower coastal-jet definition or whole Agulhas system.
layer: Regional upper-ocean current geography; no fixed depth or velocity axis extracted.
time_convention: Undated editorial reference sketch, not an instantaneous or reanalysis mean axis.
source_locator: Regional and Shelf-Scale / The Agulhas Current System: regional 27–40 degrees S description, retroflection at 18–20 degrees E and eastward return-current distinction; broader/early retroflections discussed separately.
source_citation: Russo, Veitch, Carr, Fearon and Whittle (2022), An Intercomparison of Global Reanalysis Products for Southern Africa’s Major Oceanographic Features, Frontiers in Marine Science 9, 837906.
source_license: Factual geographic references only; no source prose, figure, provider geometry or model field packaged.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects offshore regional waypoints and a nominal 19 degrees E turning gate. The source supports regional extent and flow identity, not these coordinates, a continuous measured axis, shelf contour or a unique current termination.
scenario_rule: Three uniform longitude shifts (-0.25/0/+0.25 degrees), three independent endpoint latitude shifts (-0.5/0/+0.5 degrees) and three turning-gate longitude shifts (-1/0/+1 degrees): 81 assumption scenarios. These do not span every early retroflection or supply an empirical uncertainty distribution.
remaining_gates: Independent review of regional extent versus coastal-jet naming and the retroflection/return handoff.
Validate offshore waypoints against reproducible bathymetric or velocity geometry; extend endpoint scenarios if warranted.
Canonical geometry/measurement integration and publication review before admission.
method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
